new_edge_mathematical_reviews.conditions: Same finite unit-customer labeled catalog, m≥1 unit sequential players, same complete ordered-history pure SPE σ; regret only at surviving original actual nodes; prescribed action is an admissible candidate.
proof_reconstruction: For every survivor ordered history, simulate σ recursively, inserting virtual σ_i action when original position i is reached. Later original prescriptions use that simulated original history including the virtual action. This deterministic function of σ and survivor history gives a complete m−1-player plan τ_i without adding observable information or a real player.

For j<i forced action T, the virtual deleted theme is reselected from the changed original history. Before deleting its load, the resulting leaf is precisely the original same-σ true deviation leaf; its current-player payoff v≤u_j by original IC. Freezing actual S_i in these branches would be wrong, and neither edge nor body does so.

If that branch covers a customer also covered by the virtual role, original load l≥2 and deletion gain is 1/[l(l−1)]≤1/l. Sum gives Δ≤v≤u_j. Original actual leaf after deletion pays u_j+A_ij. Hence regret ≤v+Δ−u_j−A_ij≤u_j−A_ij. Prescribed action gives ≥0; actual A_ij≤u_j makes the bound nonnegative.

For j>i, the unchanged original actual past contains S_i, so ASD applies exactly: 0≤r_ij≤min{u_j,K_ij}−A_ij. In particular b_j(x)≥1 on S_i, and K_ij is the legal S_i theme envelope, not a fabricated union.

A_ij=Σ_(x∈S_i∩S_j)1/[c_x(c_x−1)] for every i≠j. Each actual overlapping customer with c_x≥2 has c_x(c_x−1) directed distinct-coverer pairs, each paying the reciprocal; it contributes exactly1. Therefore Σ_(i≠j)A_ij=D, and each i<j / i>j triangle contributes D/2.
D is the number of actual customers covered at least twice, not total multiplicity, repeated coverage excess, total welfare or a sum over counterfactual leaves.

Adding j>i and j<i bounds once yields Σ_iΣ_(j≠i)r_ij≤Σ_(i<j)min{u_j,K_ij}+Σ_j(m−j)u_j−D. min≤u_j and root Σu_j=W give coefficient (j−1)+(m−j)=m−1, hence ≤(m−1)W−D. Empty sums cover m1, zero customers and empty themes.
